title: 第3章 祸害一方第4章 小有凶名
slug: 看见血条的我选择打爆世界
content_zh:
【你领悟了‘力劈华山’，掌握了一种刀术】
【力劈华山，lv1（110）】
【效果：协调全身，气力凝聚，由上至下挥砍一击。】
当只有周元能听到的提示音响起时，他顿感一阵无法形容的舒畅感，好似多年的压力一朝释放。
“哈哈哈···，我成了！”
三个村汉看着狂笑的周元，无奈的摇了摇头。
作孽啊，石头以前虽然憨憨傻傻的，但贵在老实忠厚，乡里乡亲言语一声，啥脏活累活都抢着干。
现在好了一张募兵令，把一个傻小子吓疯了，别说干活了，不逃跑就谢天谢地了。
大家尽量照顾这小子，让他衣来伸手、饭来张口，为的不就是给他宽心，让他不再疯癫加剧吗。
可谁能料到，砍个柴，还能砍的疯癫加剧了。
三个村汉各自对视一眼，深深的叹了口气。
“遭瘟的差役，傻子都给你们逼疯了。”
末了，三人嘴上又嘟囔几句。
石头也是个孬种，不就服个兵役吗，老少爷们谁不得走上一遭，咋还没上路就先吓疯了。
小声交流的村汉们并没有发现，周元面前的枯木断裂十分整齐，那截面的平整度，很难被锈钝的柴刀砍出。
“砰。”
【力劈华山，经验+1】
此时的周元异常痛快，他一刀接着一刀，很快砍好了今天的柴火，技能‘力劈华山’也升到了2级。
“我大概砍了三十刀，却只增加了十二点经验，看来不是每刀必有经验。
不过这已经很好了，我知道该怎么获取技能了，关键是全神贯注、不断思考改正。”

技能与经验的出现，使周元非常兴奋。
直到此刻，他才感觉自己抓住了机会的轨迹，获得了生存的资格。
当他准备继续砍柴，争取将‘力劈华山’这个技能升到满级时，才发现自己握紧柴刀的双手，已经不自觉的打起了摆子。
他终究有一副血肉之躯，无法像真正的游戏人物一般，不知疲倦、身若金刚。
于是，他抛下柴刀，准备利用之前的成功经验，锻炼一项战场绝技‘跑步’。
众所周知，只要跑的比自己人快，生存几率就会大大增加。
毕竟，周元现在只是一个村民，他的脑壳不会比其他村汉更值钱。
“咋了石头，不练啦？”
“我已练成‘力劈大山’，正要琢磨其他武技。
大黄叔，你们要是信我，就来我院里砍柴，别的不敢说，至少能教会你们怎么极限一换一。”
“呸，一换一还用你教。
人戳我一枪，老子不往后退，也戳他一枪不就行了。”
“话是这么说，可真打起来的时候，咱们面对的也不是一杠枪、一柄刀啊。
练好我这法子，能保你们拉个垫背的，不过有前提啊，对面不能是甲兵。”
“得，那你这法子还不如我的呐。
甭管对面有甲无甲，咱老少爷们一块用劲，把他戳到，踩也踩死他。”
“有水平啊大黄叔，你这是上过战场？”
“没，俺爹去过，他老人家走前说过，服兵役啥都是虚的，就大枪最实惠。
只要练好刺枪回手，比什么都强。”
“有点道理，等会儿给我找个长木棍，我也练练刺枪。”
content_en:
[You have understood ‘Cleaving Huashan Mountain with force’ and mastered a sword technique]
[Strike Huashan with force, lv1 (110)]
[Effect: Coordinate the whole body, condense the energy, and slash from top to bottom. 】
When the beep that only Zhou Yuan could hear sounded, he felt an indescribable sense of relief, as if years of stress had been released.
"Hahaha..., I'm done!"
The three villagers looked at Zhou Yuan who was laughing wildly and shook their heads helplessly.
What a sin. Although Shitou was naive and silly in the past, he was honest and loyal. The villagers would rush to do any dirty work at the word of a word.
Now there is a recruitment order, which scares a stupid boy crazy. Let alone work, thank God if he doesn't run away.
Everyone tried their best to take care of this kid, and let him have clothes to stretch out his hands and food to open his mouth. Isn't that to give him peace of mind and prevent him from getting madder?
But who would have expected that the madness will intensify even after cutting firewood.
The three villagers each looked at each other and sighed deeply.
"The plagued officers and fools have driven you crazy."
Finally, the three of them muttered a few more words.
Shitou is also a coward. Why don't you just serve in the military? No one, old or young, is allowed to do this. Why are you so frightened that you go crazy before you even get on the road?
The villagers who were communicating in low voices did not realize that the dead wood in front of Zhou Yuan was broken very neatly, and the flatness of the cross section made it difficult to cut out with a blunt hatchet.
"Bang."
[Strike Huashan with force, experience +1]
Zhou Yuan was extremely happy at this time. He cut one knife after another and quickly chopped today's firewood. His skill 'Splitting Huashan with Power' was also upgraded to level 2.
"I cut about thirty times, but only gained twelve points of experience. It seems that experience is not necessarily gained with every cut.
But this is already good. I know how to acquire skills. The key is to concentrate and keep thinking about corrections. "
The emergence of skills and experience made Zhou Yuan very excited.
It was only at this moment that he felt that he had caught the opportunity and gained the qualification to survive.
When he was about to continue chopping firewood and strive to upgrade the skill of 'Strengthening Huashan' to the full level, he realized that his hands holding the hatchet were shaking unconsciously.
After all, he has a body of flesh and blood, so he cannot be tireless and like a real game character.
So, he put down the hatchet and prepared to use his previous successful experience to practice a battlefield stunt called "running".
As we all know, as long as you run faster than your own people, your chances of survival will be greatly increased.
After all, Zhou Yuan is just a villager now, and his head is not more valuable than other villagers.
"What's wrong with the stone? Why don't you practice?"
“I have already mastered ‘Strength Splitting Mountains’ and am about to consider other martial arts skills.
Uncle Dahuang, if you believe me, come to my yard to cut firewood. I dare not say anything else. At least I can teach you how to change your limits. "
"Bah, I need you to teach me if I change one for another.
If someone pokes me, if I don't step back, I can just poke him. "
"That being said, when it comes to fighting, what we are facing is not just a gun or a knife.
Practice my method well, and I can ensure that you have a backing, but there is a prerequisite: the opponent cannot be an armored soldier. "
"Yeah, then your method is not as good as mine.
Regardless of whether the person on the other side is armored or not, we old and young men will work together to poke him and trample him to death. "
"You're good, Uncle Dahuang. Have you ever been on the battlefield?"
"No, my father has been there. Before he left, he said that everything in military service is in vain, and a big gun is the most affordable.
As long as you practice stabbing back well, you are better than anything else. "
"That makes sense. Find me a long wooden stick later, and I'll practice stabbing too."
